A '''Vurk warrior''' who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Vurk]] was a trench fighter who fought alongside [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist forces]].
